name: Exotics Share Of Open Interest
description: Kalshi Exotics Market Composition: Percentage of open interest held in combo-style exotic prediction markets (multi-leg, basket, index, cross-category) versus other exotic types.
query_sql:
WITH
exotics AS (
  SELECT
    report_ticker,
    ticker_name,
    open_interest
  FROM kalshi.market_report
  WHERE category = 'Exotics'
),
exotics_flagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN lower(report_ticker) LIKE '%crosscategory%'
        OR lower(report_ticker) LIKE '%multi%'
        OR lower(ticker_name) LIKE '%basket%'
        OR lower(ticker_name) LIKE '%index%'
      THEN 'Combo'
      ELSE 'Other'
    END AS exotic_type
  FROM exotics
)
SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN exotic_type = 'Combo' THEN open_interest ELSE 0 END) /
    NULLIF(SUM(open_interest), 0),
    1
  ) AS pct_combo_open_interest
FROM exotics_flagged;
